adjudication.typed_decode_proposal: Assumed deep immutability despite retained public mutable numeric subtype; virtual conversion and earlier validation order remain observable. Typed object checks are not JSON byte parsing, and deleting one call is not a proven parse-time saving.
adjudication.tree_conversion_proposal: Eager conversion changes branch and failure order. Filtered local projection and unfiltered fallback have different trees; alias and strict round-trip qualifications were not closed.
adjudication.already_known_fact: Payload is constructed once before bounded same-call model retries; this correct source fact was already known to the owner and is not a new finding or implementation.
adjudication.no_format_failure: Complete outer JSON is valid; source mistakes and incomplete semantic qualification do not become a transport or JSON syntax failure.
